title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
reasoning: The paper uses the CulturalFrames dataset to audit Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and one of the five specific evaluation categories explicitly benchmarked is 'Religion' (as detailed in Table 9). It evaluates how the models handle culturally and religiously situated prompts (e.g., 'Shintō priest performing purification ritual') in terms of prompt alignment and unsupported stereotyping.
